subtopics.title: Authentication in Django
subtopics.description: In this subtopic, we will explore how to implement user authentication in Django, including creating custom user models, setting up authentication backends, and integrating authentication into views and templates. We will also cover password management, email verification, and social authentication. The goal is to provide a robust and secure user authentication system for our Django applications.

subtopics.title: Internationalization and Localization in Django
subtopics.description: This subtopic focuses on how to handle internationalization and localization in Django. We will cover the use of Django's internationalization and localization features, including translation of messages, formatting of dates and numbers, and handling of different languages and character sets. We will also discuss best practices for managing translations and ensuring a consistent user experience across different locales.
